lead: Analysis of the rolling history shows steady product development and customer adoption across major EFB, flight planning, and crew management vendors, with Jeppesen, Lufthansa Systems, and IFS actively capturing new airline agreements while introducing advanced workflow and AI capabilities.

insights.title: Vendor-Specific IFS EFBOne Fleet Penetration
insights.finding: IFS secured multiple customer wins and deployments for its IFS EFBOne platform, including selections by fastjet, TUS Airways, and MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air).
insights.aviation_context: fastjet is a low-cost carrier (LCC), while TUS Airways and MY FREIGHTER operate regional/hybrid and cargo models, respectively.
insights.caveat: Recorded customer segments in the raw feed are marked as unknown; classifications are based on general industry knowledge of the named airlines.

insights.title: AI and Agentic Operations Integration in Flight Planning
insights.finding: Jeppesen introduced artificial intelligence agents into its ForeFlight and Airflow platforms, alongside Jeppesen Dispatch v2026-2.
insights.aviation_context: Corendon Airlines acted as a launch customer for Dispatch v2026-2 to expand planning automation.
insights.caveat: Evidentiary text highlights initial agent rollouts and planned features without detailing production performance outcomes.

insights.title: Lufthansa Systems Lido Flight 4D and mPilot Implementations
insights.finding: Lufthansa Systems announced implementations and deployments of its Lido software suite with Kenya Airways and Viva.
insights.aviation_context: Kenya Airways is a full-service carrier, while Viva represents an LCC or regional operator depending on the specific operating entity.
insights.caveat: The data reflects individual implementation announcements rather than an exhaustive count of active fleet deployments.

insights.title: Airbus Skywise Digital Suite Expansion via Navblue
insights.finding: Navblue and its integrated Skywise digital structure announced customer selections and operational integrations for carriers such as TransNusa and Pan American World Airways.
insights.aviation_context: TransNusa operates regional/LCC routes, whereas Pan American World Airways represents a restart/charter-oriented context.
insights.caveat: Corporate restructuring tied to the Airbus Skywise merger forms the backdrop for several digital suite announcements.

caveat: AI-generated synthesis of captured public signals; verify cited sources before making decisions.
